why: The service split (46/32/22) and the urgent-care problem pie (37/4/9/7/18/25) each sum to 100%, and 2,140 animals in a month is believable for a vet hospital.
Hand peeling at 15 kg an hour, a machine at 50 kg an hour costing $13,720 over four years and a $15 staff cost are believable, and 245 days fits working-day opening.
Each panel row is a subset no larger than the one above it for both one-person firms (5,530 to 896) and firms with staff (3,684 to 519), so the funnel is consistent.
The eight funder bars sum exactly to the $153 million total, believable research income for a university.
Every hospital's capital-spending shares sum to 100%, and $29 to $91 million over five years per hospital with 69% to 96% bed occupancy is believable.
Quillfire's mobile share falling from about 15% to 10% of a $1.2 to $2.15 billion market, and about 14% to 16% of the console market, is believable.
Practice profits of about $133,000 to $467,000 per practice across groups of 30 to 45 dental practices are believable.
94,000 motor policies, a $29 legal-cover fee and breakdown cover costing tens of dollars a year are consistent with the stated $4.39 million and believable for a broker.
Both pies sum to 100%, and 3,200 exit forms is believable for a village mountain-bike park.
Game revenues of $1 to $31 million (about $120 million in all) against 5 to 66 developers per game, roughly $450,000 per developer, are believable for a loss-making mobile studio.
